title: core.fulfillment.cancelled v1
description: Published by CORE when a fulfillment is cancelled before execution closes. MARKET closes the commercial order; MOVE stops any operational job it created.

settlement_state.description: State of the CORE money hold at closure. `released` means the hold was returned and no money moved; `partially_captured` means part of the consented amount had already moved and only the remainder was returned, so the payer has paid for work that was cancelled; `unsettled` means CORE could not bring the hold to a terminal state. The last two need reconciliation. Optional and additive; consumers may ignore it, and a consumer that reads it must treat an unrecognised value as "do not assume" rather than as `released`.
